name: Yokun Seat
generated_description:
At 2,116 feet, Yokun Seat is a summit in Massachusetts. The Yokun Seat Trail covers 2.4 miles round trip (out-and-back) with about 328 feet of elevation gain — a gradual walk with modest climbing.

The Route

Most of the climbing comes early — the first half of the route does the bulk of the work before the grade eases. The steepest stretch arrives around mile 0.09, gaining roughly 1,100 feet per mile — expect a slow, deliberate pace through here. From the trailhead at about 1,496 feet, the route tops out near 1,824 feet.

Getting There

The trailhead is at 42.35933, -73.32482 (tap for driving directions). It's roughly 30 miles southeast of Albany, New York. Arrive early on weekends — trailhead lots at popular peaks fill quickly, and cell service is often unreliable once you leave the highway.

When to Go

Spring through fall is the main season. Conditions change fast in the shoulder months — check a point forecast for the summit, not the nearest town, before you commit.

Know Before You Go

The Easy rating comes from the National Park Service difficulty formula, which weighs total distance against elevation gain. Most hikers should budget about 1.0 hours of moving time; add margin for breaks, photos and the descent. Download the GPX track from this page before you go — cell coverage is unreliable in the mountains and a saved route works offline in any GPS app. Conditions change: verify current access, closures and weather with the official land manager before you go. Trail data is sourced from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

Looking to link objectives or plan a weekend? Nearby summits include Doll Mountain, Smith Mountain and Pine Mountain — each has its own guide on this site.

faqs.answer: Rules vary by land manager — national parks often prohibit dogs on trails, while most national forests allow them on leash. Check with the managing agency for this trail before bringing your dog, and pack out waste.

faqs.answer: Late May through October for snow-free hiking. Check a summit point forecast before you go — conditions up high differ from the trailhead.

faqs.answer: Yokun Seat stands at 2,116 feet (645 meters) in Massachusetts.
